# meok-compliance-gateway

> Streamable-HTTP gateway + x402 paywall — THIS repo.
> Open. Transparent. Governed.

## Key facts

- **Domain:** meok-compliance-gateway
- **Tier:** infra
- **MCP endpoint:** https://meok-compliance-gateway/mcp (streamable-HTTP, MCP 1.27.2)
- **A2A Agent Card:** https://meok-compliance-gateway/.well-known/agent-card.json
- **Open source:** https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/meok-compliance-gateway-hive (MIT)
- **Pricing (x402 micro-call):** x402 $ 0.05/call (free tier: 1/day)
- **Pricing (SaaS tier):** Business ($49/user/mo)
- **Memory mode:** isolated
- **Knowledge subgraph scope:** MCP transport, x402 payments, usage accounting, PayGo balance

## Tools exposed (MCP)

- meok-compliance-gateway

## Cross-hive integrations

- csoai.org (wraps flagship MCPs)
- proofof.ai (x402 receipts)
- openmoe.ai (BFT receipts via x402)

## Brand

- **Palette:** gateway slate + x402 amber
- **Voice:** Wrapper, hermetic, instrumented. Speaks in `Mcp-Method` headers and atomic units.
